summary: He admires them and notes the early deaths.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: After, you mentioned Dizzy, too, and that sort of reminded me that we haven't really talked about Dizzy and, you know, a lot of the younger players, you know, past the be-bop era. Who are some of the worthy trumpet players in that tradition that you think have contributed?
Well, besides Dizzy. Now, they had a trumpet player. A young man, he died when he was 21, accident. Oh, boy. He was, he was marvelous. I believe that name may come up pretty soon.
You're talking about Clifford Brown (inaudible). Yeah. I think he was younger than me. Yeah. He was great. He was some trumpet player. I admired him very much.
Let's see. What about Fats Navarro or Freddie Hubbard?
Fats, I knew him. Freddie Hubbard. You call some good names.
Yeah. They was marvelous and I admired them. Fats left us too, didn't he?
Yeah. You calling some good names. We had some good, some good boys down there.
